Clustered heatmap of a numeric matrix, saved directly to png

Source: R/plots.R
plot_heatmap.Rd

Wraps gplots::heatmap.2() with complete-linkage/Euclidean clustering, a diverging RdBu palette sized to the data range, row side-colors from cutree() cluster assignment, and column side-colors derived from annotation's group column — then writes the result straight to file as a png (the function has no return value; it is called for this side effect).

Usage

plot_heatmap(
  mat,
  annotation,
  level,
  group,
  n_clust = 5,
  width = 24,
  height = 24,
  units = "cm",
  res = 100,
  keysize = 0.9,
  file,
  ...
)

Arguments

mat

Numeric matrix to cluster and plot (e.g. output of get_mat_log2area()).

annotation

Annotation data frame; must contain the level and group columns (level matches mat's column names, group colors them).

level

Column (string) in annotation matching mat's columns.

group

Column (string) in annotation used to color columns.

n_clust

Number of row clusters to cut the dendrogram into.

width, height, units, res

Passed to grDevices::png().

keysize

Passed to gplots::heatmap.2().

file

Output png file path.

...

Additional arguments passed to gplots::heatmap.2().

Value

Invisible NULL; called for its side effect of writing file.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_heatmap(mat_log2area, annotation, level = "Sample", group = "Condition",
             file = file.path("4_figures", "hm_pep_all_log2area_br_nonscaled.png"))
} # }
